svg.title: LeJEPA training step
svg.desc: An unlabeled image becomes 2 global and 4 local views; one shared encoder and projector map every view to an embedding z; the loss is (1 - lambda) times the prediction term (every view's z toward the mean of the global views) plus lambda times SIGReg (Epps-Pulley test of random 1-D projections of z against N(0,1)).
svg.text: μn = mean of the 2 global-view zg,n
every view, global and local, predicts
the centre of the global views
pushes each view's batch toward N(0, I)
no decoder, no EMA teacher, no stop-gradient
one hyperparameter trades the two terms
Colours: teal views · amber encoder · violet projector/embeddings · blue L_pred · magenta-red SIGReg
